patches.name: Crash of Cars Anti-hacking Check
patches.description: Stops the game's built-in tamper detector from flagging the app as modified. The game ships a native check that fingerprints classes.dex and quietly marks the app as not genuine whenever the fingerprint does not match the one it was built with — which is exactly what happens the moment any mod is applied, since changing the app inevitably changes that fingerprint. With this on, the game keeps reporting itself as a normal, unmodified install, so purchases and other store features are not silently suppressed.

patches.name: Crash of Cars Free IAP
patches.description: Every store item — coin packs, gem bundles, remove ads and the starter bundles — is granted the instant you tap Buy, and no Google Play payment sheet ever opens. Because nothing is fetched from Play, purchases work fully offline with no Play account, and remove-ads stays unlocked across restarts since the entitlement is re-delivered from a fake owned-purchases list at every launch.

patches.name: Crash of Cars Instant Ad Rewards
patches.description: Turns every "watch a video" offer into an instant payout. Coins, gems and boosters that the game offers in exchange for sitting through a rewarded advert are credited the moment you tap, with no video to play, no countdown and no waiting — and the offer stays repeatable afterwards, so you can claim it as often as you like. Works with no internet connection and the reward stays credited after restarting the game.

patches.name: Crash of Cars No Ads
patches.description: Removes the full-screen advert that plays at the end of every race, so the results screen comes up straight away instead of behind an ad you have to sit through or skip. The race still finishes normally — the game is told the advert opened and closed exactly as it would have been, so nothing gets stuck waiting for it. Works offline and survives restarts, because no part of the ad display depends on a network round trip.

patches.name: Crash of Cars Sideload / APK Expansion Bypass
patches.description: IMPORTANT: this patch only removes the licensing gate — it does NOT supply the game data. The 153 MB expansion file must already be on your device before the game will start. Copy main.<versionCode>.com.notdoppler.crashofcars.obb into Android/obb/com.notdoppler.crashofcars/ (on most phones that is the internal Android/obb folder, not the one on the SD card) using a file manager or an ADB push. If the file is missing or in the wrong place the game will still stall on the loading screen no matter what this patch does. Aside from that: lets the game start from a sideloaded APK instead of a Google Play install. The downloader refuses to use the expansion file even when it is present because Play's licensing server rejects a re-signed package, so the game stops on "Download failed because you may not have purchased this app" before it ever reaches the menu. This forces the expansion downloader past both gates: it always reports success instead of a stale or unlicensed error, and it always takes the licensed path when Play answers. The expansion data is still md5-verified file by file exactly as shipped, so a genuinely incomplete or corrupt download is still reported rather than silently ignored.

patches.name: Firebase Cert Spoof
patches.description: Restores Firebase requests on a re-signed APK. The Firebase API key is restricted to the Play build's package + signing certificate, so Installations, Remote Config, Auth and Storage requests from a patched build are rejected with API_KEY_ANDROID_APP_BLOCKED. This patch forces the certificate hash Firebase sends in X-Android-Cert to the original signing certificate's SHA-1, so those requests are accepted again. It does not fix the Start-workout crash — that was a native asset-decryption check covered by the Signature Spoof patch. It also does not make Google Sign-In work — that is validated server-side against the developer's OAuth client and cannot be patched (use the unpatched app for cloud sync).

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Unlocks the paid "Remove ads" product locally, so the app behaves as if it was purchased: banners, native, interstitial, app-open and splash ads stop, and the "Remove ads" row disappears from settings. No Play payment is involved and the entitlement survives restarts. Rewarded ads are left untouched. Requires the Signature Spoof patch in the same bundle for the patched APK to start. Google Sign-In / Backup & Restore does not work on a re-signed APK: the app's OAuth client is bound to the developer's signing certificate and Google refuses token issuance server-side, so no microG-style patch or signature spoof can bypass it. Use the unpatched app if you need cloud sync.

patches.name: Signature Spoof
patches.description: Neutralises the app's built-in certificate verifier so the patched APK keeps running. The app re-reads its own signing certificate on every screen and compares 46 hardcoded slices of it against baked-in values; because patching always re-signs the APK, those comparisons fail and the app force-closes while the first activity is being created. With this patch every verifier reports the original, unmodified certificate instead, so all 46 checks pass. The bundled native library runs two further certificate checks: one stops the library from loading, and one silently stops workout data from being decrypted, which crashes the app the moment you tap Start. Both are bypassed as well. This patch is required — the app can neither start nor open a workout without it.

patches.name: Swift Backup Local Cloud Metadata
patches.description: Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on the device and the connected cloud instead of the Swift Backup server.

patches.name: Swift Backup Premium Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks all Premium features.

patches.name: Swift Backup Tamper Protection
patches.description: Stops the app from closing itself on patched installs.

patches.name: Swift Backup Web Login
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in work for connecting cloud accounts.

patches.name: Missiles Ads Removal
patches.description: Spoofs the Google Mobile Ads Unity bridge (AdMob): interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, app open and banner ads resolve instantly as loaded/showed/closed/rewarded without ever displaying an ad.

patches.name: Missiles Billing Bypass
patches.description: Spoofs the Google Play Billing 8.0.0 purchase flow: every buy is instantly granted (fake Purchase delivered through the registered listener), purchases/consumes complete instantly, and the product catalog is served with fake ProductDetails — no Google Play sheet, no real payment.

patches.name: Missiles License Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses the Pairip Play Store license check so the app launches normally.
